evidence.locator: BDA page dated 2/20/2026; title '2025 eye health & blood sugar community screening report'; byline 'The Bermuda Diabetes Association Team'; body and 2025 summary-report link
evidence.issuer: Bermuda Diabetes Association (first-party webpage author and host)
evidence.qualification: First-party webpage is accessible and confirms the November 12–13, 2025 two-day voluntary eye-health/blood-sugar screening with Lahey Hospital & Medical Center as collaborator. The HTML mentions 'nearly half' of attendees showing signs of at least one screened eye condition and 21% needing ophthalmology follow-up within one to three months. It is a brief event/results summary, not an inspected original PDF report or fully appraisable study/methods section. Lahey collaboration does not prove Lahey authored or issued the linked PDF. No S1/S2/H status, disease prevalence, diagnostic estimate or clinical suitability is established by the HTML alone.

evidence.issuer: International Diabetes Federation (directory publisher, not screening-report author)
evidence.qualification: Independent affiliation/organization identity context only. IDF membership is not evidence of the content or study design of this November 2025 screening report, clinical endorsement, governance approval or scientific validity.

evidence.locator: February 27, 2026 article reproducing BDA spokesperson statements about the November 12–13, 2025 screenings
evidence.issuer: Bernews (secondary news outlet quoting BDA statements)
evidence.qualification: Secondary coverage reports 72 eye-screening attendees aged 29–96 and 74% women, with roughly half having signs of one of several eye conditions and 21% referred for ophthalmology follow-up. It also reports that half of the separate HbA1c-tested group measured at least 7% but does not provide that test group's denominator. The 72 refers to eye-screening participants, not a verified HbA1c denominator, a probability sample, Bermuda-wide prevalence, clinical diagnostic accuracy or a PDF methodology check. Article is not an independently reviewed primary study.

evidence.locator: March 5, 2026 local report of BDA's November screening event and aggregated observations
evidence.issuer: The Royal Gazette (secondary reporting of BDA statements)
evidence.qualification: Separately published local reporting is consistent with 72 event eye-screening attendees and approximate eye screening findings but appears to rely on BDA-supplied figures. This does not independently reproduce the PDF, validate sample selection, establish the HbA1c denominator or independently verify clinical effect size.
